architecture: MACE: Higher-order O(3)-equivariant message-passing neural network with many-body messages
training_data: MPtrj dataset (~1.5M inorganic crystal structures and relaxation trajectories, 89 elements)

water_rdf.method: Langevin MD at 330K with 32 H2O molecules
water_rdf.validation: Peak positions at ~2.8 Å (first shell) and ~4.5 Å (second shell)

adsorption_scaling.method: BFGS relaxation of fcc(111) slabs with O and OH adsorbates
adsorption_scaling.output: Linear scaling relation E_ads(OH) vs E_ads(O)

reaction_barriers.method: Single-point MACE energies at reactant and TS geometries

limitations: MD simulation limited to 200 steps (0.1 ps) vs 2000 steps specified
Transition state geometries not optimized within MACE framework
Rxn 11 uses simplified geometry not corresponding to MACE saddle point
float64 CPU-only computation, slower than GPU inference
fallback_deviations: Reduced MD steps from 2000 to 200 due to computational constraints
Used single-point energies at provided geometries instead of NEB-optimized barriers
